verdict.line: You lose if you eat Sion's Q and let him toggle Enrage into free autos; you win if you dodge Q and all-in with Conqueror stacked before his shield or R comes online.

brief.thesis: Sion's entire kill threat is the single-target stun from Q (Cryptic Gaze, 550 range) — he has no other hard CC, and at rank 1 it's on a 12s cooldown, so every whiff is a long dead window. Riven's Q-W-Q-E combo chains a knockback and a stun that out-trades anything Sion can do without his Q up, which is why Riven holds both the overall lane edge and the solo-kill edge in the 75-game sample (50.7% win rate).

theirWindow.when: Right after Sion lands his Q stun
theirWindow.what: He'll chain Enrage-boosted autos and poke with W's shield while you're locked down. Use E (Valor) to block part of the follow-up damage and disengage rather than trading back blind.

yourWindow.when: Sion's Q is down or just whiffed
yourWindow.what: He has zero CC left to stop your combo. Walk him down with Q-W-Q-E immediately — this is exactly where Riven's solo-kill advantage in this matchup comes from.

start.why: Sustains you through early Q-bait trades and feeds Runic Blade's auto-attack bonus damage, which is how you punish his Q cooldown before level 3.

boots.why: The ability haste shortens Q/E cooldowns, giving you more frequent Valor dashes to dodge his 550-range Q and more Broken Wings resets per trade window.

core.why: Rewards landing your burst combo on him before his W shield can absorb it, and its shield helps you survive the Enrage-boosted return autos.
Sustain and scaling damage to keep winning extended skirmishes once his R (Cannibalism) comes online at 6.
Converts his delayed Enrage/Cannibalism damage into ticks you can heal through, letting you finish all-ins instead of trading even.

sion has stacked max health from kills and is starting to tank your damage

runes.keystoneWhy: Melee-range skirmishes with Sion's E toggled on are exactly the extended trades Conqueror is built for, and the adaptive damage ramp punishes him for staying in auto range.

summoners.why: 97.6% of Rivens in this matchup run Flash+Ignite — Ignite closes out the all-in the moment his Q is down, which is where your solo-kill edge actually gets converted into a kill.

playing.title: Track his Q cooldown all lane
playing.detail: It's his only stun and starts at a 12s cooldown. Walk at odd angles near max range to bait a whiff, then punish immediately.

playing.title: All-in the instant Q is down
playing.detail: Chain Q-W-Q-E before he can reset — he has no other CC to stop you, and this is where Riven's measured solo-kill advantage comes from.

playing.title: Don't facecheck his shield point-blank
playing.detail: Death's Caress is a 100-range shield that explodes in an area when it expires or he reactivates it. Burst through it fast or back off instead of standing inside the pop.

playing.title: Watch for Enrage flicker before he commits
playing.detail: E has no cooldown, so he can toggle it on right before trading for extra AD at the cost of his own health. That's a window to punish — he's lower effective HP than his bar shows.

playing.title: Shorten fights once he hits level 6
playing.detail: Cannibalism lets him leech health and gain attack speed on a 90s cooldown. Take quick trades, not drawn-out auto wars, until you've confirmed it's down.

playing.title: Save R's Wind Slash to finish
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile gives you one ranged execute shot — hold it for when he's low rather than using it just for the AD/range buff.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner picks above are measured from live Riven-vs-Sion games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability readings, timing windows, and trade patterns are my own tactical analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Dodge Sion’s (Q) with your abilities. Nuke Sion if his abilities are on cooldown while your Conqueror’s stacks are up.
